description:
750W Powerful Motor
This electric bike is equipped with a powerful and stable 750W motor that delivers reliable and consistent power for your daily rides. Its maximum speed of approximately 20 miles per hour in mode 3 makes it ideal for commuting and camping.
Large Capacity Removable Battery
This exceptional fat tire electric bike boasts a 48V 15Ah removable lithium battery, seamlessly integrated within its structure. Experience a riding range of 25-30 miles in pure Ebike mode, and 35-75 miles in PAS mode. It is important to note that the actual range may fluctuate based on variables such as the rider's weight and the prevailing road conditions. The ebike offers two charging options: direct charging or separate charging after removing the battery.
Adjustable Handlebar & Foldable Design
Indulge in the versatility of the adjustable handlebar, tailored to your specific preferences. It can be effortlessly modified within a range of 46.46 to 51.18 inches. Moreover, the unique foldable design facilitates easy storage and transportation, making it an ideal companion for outdoor activities and short excursions.
Dual Shock Absorber & Disc Brake
Experience unrivaled comfort during your rides with the front suspension fork, effectively minimizing the impact of bumps along your journey. The high-quality dual disc brakes ensure enhanced safety and security, elevating your cycling experience to new heights.
After-Sale Service and Support
The BK11M e-bike comes pre-assembled and we provide an installation video and user manual which you can view via our YouTube channel. Our unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction is backed by a 1 year warranty and dedicated customer support to ensure you have peace of mind throughout your e-bike journey.
*We'll throw in a shock-absorbing seat at random.
